skills.name: gmx-trading
skills.description: Trade GMX perpetuals and swap tokens using GmxApiSdk. Use for market, limit, stop, TP/SL and TWAP orders, position management, and market or account reads on Arbitrum, Avalanche, and MegaETH.

skills.name: gmx-liquidity
skills.description: Query GMX GM pools and GLV vaults with GmxApiSdk, and provide or withdraw liquidity through current contracts. Use for pool discovery, APY and earnings, GM/GLV deposits and withdrawals, and GM pool shifts on Arbitrum, Avalanche, and MegaETH.
